metadata.description: Household money skills for AI agents — balancing retirement saving, debt, emergency funds, and goals, for households earning under $200K

plugins.name: money-ops-skills
plugins.description: Household money skills plus a shared context file: a priority ladder for balancing retirement saving, debt, an emergency fund, kids' college and other goals, plus a retirement account plan for 401(k), 403(b), 457(b), HSA and Roth or traditional IRA, plus a market downturn plan that sorts savings by when they're needed and writes rules for a drop, each with an Excel workbook
